Using the constant multiple and product rules, we can write the summation as

−3∑i=1m(xi+xi−1)Δxi⋅∑j=1nΔyj.

Note that ∑j=1nΔyj is just the length of the interval [8,9]. So, we have

∑j=1nΔyj=9−8=1.

For the sum over i, we evaluate it as follows:

∑i=1m(xi+xi−1)Δxi=(x1+x0)Δx1+(x2+x1)Δx2+⋯+(xm+xm−1)Δxn=(x1+x0)(x1−x0)+(x2+x1)(x2−x1)+⋯+(xm+xm−1)(xm−xm−1)=(x12−x02)+(x22−x12)+⋯+(xm2−xm−12)=(x12−x02)+(x22−x12)+⋯+(xm2−xm−12)=−x02+xm2=xm2−x02=(−1)2−(−4)2=−15

Combining our results, we finally arrive at

−3∑i=1m(xi+xi−1)Δxi⋅∑j=1nΔyj=(−3)⋅(−15)⋅1=45.
